number of samples the Taxon_orig occurs in (NE lake BCG dataset)

TaxaID_orig translated to an ID that is used for the Northeast Lake Diatom BCG (version 1) metric calculations. It harmonizes differences such as syntax, changes in nomenclature, misspellings, etc. DNI = not included.
yes = Taxon_orig is different from the ID that is used for the Northeast Lake Diatom BCG (version 1) ; no = no difference

primary source, in order of priority: 1) NELakeHarmonization_2022_Step2 (Potapova et al. 2022); 2) NELakeVoucherFlora_2022 (Potapova et al. 2022); 3) DONA (https://diatoms.org/); 4) algaebase (https://www.algaebase.org/); 5) Charles, D.F. et al. 1990 (Asterionella ralfsii var. americana (45 um). There were 290 taxa with 1 or 2 occurrences that did not match with Sources 1-3 and were not checked in algaebase.
entries if there were differences across sources
entry = if matched with algaebase but only as a Heterotypic Synonym (we only counted matches in algaebase if they were Homotypic Synonyms)
slashed taxa (combination of more than one taxon). For example, Lindavia bodanica/Lindavia intermedia
provisional = preliminary (not fully verified). Does not match with the primary sources
type of modification such as misspelling, naming convention, translation, etc.
